notes: Old ruins now stand at the front of your plot.
New menu look to match the game; the old borders are gone.
Smooth menu battle and smoother sieges.
Bots build producers again.
Coarser grid: segments snap to half cells.
Nearby nodes are marked; a note shows when you need more gold.
Thicker wood and metal, and longer segments.
Test now runs your castle's physics for a few seconds.
Smoother siege view: no more texture sliding when it zooms.
How to Play and an Upgrades list on the menu.
The siege view frames your trebuchet and the castle up close.
Bots build one big keep with a room for each royal.
New painted look: sky, green hills, gray stone, timber trebuchet.
Royals are painted, face the incoming shot and fall when killed.
Gold, ore and stone seams show in the ground.
Esc cancels a half-placed segment.
New bottom bar with icons, prices and tips.
Pause menu with settings: press Esc.
The camera follows your shot smoothly and waits for it to land.
Castles are closer and easier to hit; shots are bigger.
New trick: Bounce.
Click twice to place a segment; Z to undo.
War drums near the end of each timer, new music, and royal death cries.
A live siege behind the menu, and bots with names.
Smoother: no pause when a view first appears.
Bots start shooting as soon as a siege begins.
Castle beams show their wood, stone and metal at every zoom.
Royals are bigger, about a room tall, so you can see who is who.
Bots build huts that fit their royals, even on slopes.
Bots shelter their royals on hilly ground.
Royals are drawn to the same scale as castles.
New look for the royals, with faces you can read.
A border of beasts and birds runs along the top.
Trees on the hills.
The siege view no longer shows past the edge of the world.
Finer aim: a slightly later release throws slightly farther.
Bots no longer freeze the game at the start of a siege.
The trebuchet now swings at a steady speed, with a real sling and counterweight.
Its longest throw is shorter.
The camera stays on the trebuchet for a moment after each throw.
First playable version: build a castle, then besiege your rivals.
Play against bots, or with friends online.
Everything is stitched in wool on linen.
Menus, settings and the online lobby.
